blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez’s bail hearing at the Sandiganbayan Third Division for his plunder case began Monday, with the accused attending via video conference from detention facility. Romualdez also signed the pretrial order remotely at the New Quezon City Jail of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology in Barangay Payatas. READ: Sandiganbayan grants Romualdez motion to sign pre-trial order at QC jail The prosecution is set to present 23 witnesses during the bail hearing, which will be held every Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.
